== Published English Original Virtual Set 9 wording ==
The later free deployment permission requires a pilot and explicitly bypasses presence or Force icons. The scout-pilot discount is removed. A scout forfeiture replaces the original automatic damage protection for a solitary piloted ship. The historical full face adds here, which matches where the participating scout is forfeited under the period rules.
